meta.title: Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers Welfare Board
meta.source: Illustrative Gig Workers Welfare Board extract
meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative POC data. Every figure on this page is fictional and is not a Board figure.
meta.boundaryNote: District boundaries follow the Census 2011 outline. Vijayanagara is not drawn separately on this illustrative map. Its figures are listed under the map and included in every total.
meta.locationNote: District shows the operating district reported at registration. It does not show where a worker lives or works on a given day.
meta.activityRuleNote: POC placeholder, not a Board-approved rule: a worker is active in a month when a payout was reported for that month. The rule and its effective date are configuration.
meta.feeNote: Welfare fee rates in this POC are placeholders set for each sector with an effective date. They are not notified rates.
meta.schemeNote: Scheme status in this POC is sample master data. It does not state which benefits are notified or open for applications.

benchmark.text: The New Indian Express reported on 29 April 2026 that 23 aggregators had provided data covering 12.19 lakh gig worker records. Workers may be associated with more than one platform, so this is a count of records and not of unique workers.
